bollymeter.basis: IMDb series rating of 7.3 and status as Viki's most-watched worldwide during broadcast reflect the show's fanbase strength; the lie-detection fantasy hook and Kim So-hyun and Hwang Min-hyun's chemistry are the consensus draw.

seasons.review_body: My Lovely Liar aired on tvN from July to September 2023 and quickly became the most-watched program on Viki worldwide during its run - a metric that reflects its fanbase's devotion rather than formal critical validation. The premise deploys a clean fantasy mechanic: Mok Sol-hee (Kim So-hyun) hears a physical sound when anyone in her presence tells a lie, which makes her a useful, unusual protagonist for a murder-adjacent mystery that wraps itself in rom-com packaging. Hwang Min-hyun as composer-suspect Kim Do-ha is the structural mystery and the romantic lead simultaneously, a dual role the show navigates with enough tonal control to keep the two registers from cancelling each other out. At 16 episodes it runs longer than its premise strictly requires; the midpoint stretch thins the mystery while thickening the romance, a trade-off the audience appeared willing to accept. The tvN premiere drew 2.589% nationwide ratings - modest for the slot - but word-of-mouth built the show into an international Viki hit, a common trajectory for mid-tier cable K-dramas with standout lead chemistry.

episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The premiere establishes Sol-hee's ability with playful efficiency and positions Do-ha as a puzzle rather than a threat, setting up a mystery-romance where the heroine's superpower is both asset and vulnerability.
